chair_support.source_quote: The wooden chair beside the staircase is missing. Restore its wooden frame and upholstered seat using the supplied initial .blend scene and two complete reference images. Match the proportions, silhouette, materials, ground support and occlusion; do not substitute simple boxes or whole-image billboards. Approximate overall chair bounds are (-0.528,2.120,0.023) m to (0.351,3.061,1.550) m. These are location and scale hints, not a box to fill. Preserve all other furniture, architecture, materials, lights and cameras; choose your own subdivision of new parts. Use metres and right-handed Z-up coordinates. Render main.png with the initial scene camera. For alternate.png, translate a copy of that camera by 0.28 m along its own local X axis, retaining rotation and lens settings. Render both with Cycles, 960×540, AgX and exposure 0; preserve the remaining source render settings. Submit reproducible editing code, scene.blend with complete textures and both images, retaining both output cameras.
chair_support.rationale: Task-stated setting or dimension; tolerances and geometric algorithms still need representative calibration.
